parameters.name: BackendPort
parameters.description: The origin server port. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendPort
parameters.description: The forward port. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendProtocol
parameters.description:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:

- **tcp**: TCP protocol.
- **udp**: UDP protocol.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the port forwarding rule belongs.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: ProxyEnable
parameters.description:
The traffic redirection switch. Valid values:
- **0**: disabled.
- **1**: enabled.

parameters.name: RealServers
parameters.description: The list of origin server IP addresses.
